purpose: Remove the GPU1 host-mediated channel-estimator-to-TensorRT stream transition after GC OFF did not reduce the raw-P2P tail.
prior_results: Raw-P2P v1 completed 852/1000 within 4.5 ms; GPU1 NeuralRx p99 was 9.61 ms.
GC-OFF v2 completed 838/1000 within 4.5 ms; GPU1 NeuralRx p99 remained 9.42 ms.
intervention: Retain raw-P2P and GC OFF, but run channel estimation, TensorRT, LDPC, and CRC through the same pyAerial CUDA stream rather than the DirectNrx cross-stream host-synchronized path.
claim_boundary: This two-GPU clean isolated test is neither a production d_MAC qualification nor a WCET bound. It omits MPS, external AI, a real DU clock, and real channels.
decision_rule: Report pair-completion counts at 4.5 ms; do not promote sample statistics to a bound. End the production diagnostic after this intervention.
